items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: You and your wife, too, I think. That was your wife with you, Delvin.

ctx.x: other day that started about 10, 10.30. Went on toward three o'clock in the afternoon. Oh, no. Just

amazed how long. No, he's my, I passed it. And he's such a wonderful little speaker. You would be, oh, he's so intelligent, you know. He don't have all that old, old-time mess, you know. He's just, just an intelligent speaker. And he just speaks so lovely. And then the choirs we have, we don't have, we used to have a youth choir, but we don't have it anymore. We have, um, the gospel choir and the senior choir. But they sing so beautifully. You would appreciate it so much. You and your wife, too, I think. That was…
Well, thank you. You and I agree on that. She's a wonderful girl.
